description: National Film Corporation of Sri Lanka - Declare that all tasks pertaining to distribution of films including the scheduling of films for Cinema Halls, etc will be performed by National Film Corporation of Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with legal and regulatory matters. It is a notification published by the Chairman of the National Film Corporation exercising powers vested under the National Film Corporation of Sri Lanka Act (No. 47 of 1971 as amended). The content establishes new regulatory frameworks, procedures, and compliance requirements for film distribution, importation, registration, categorization, and screening within Sri Lanka. It cancels previous private distribution arrangements and implements a new legal methodology for film distribution, making it a clear example of legal/regulatory gazette content.
